scope: protocol dose-response card: the per-error update budget is the only independent variable; no new structure, no new read, no width change

read_code.rule: zeros(24); code[class] = 1.0; both branches receive the same code at joint_readout
read_code.injection: forward hook on joint_readout replaces its output with joint_readout(code); training, evaluation and feedback use the same path
read_code.limitation: the code carries the read's four-way answer, not the scene's pixels; a pass measures byte expression, not content-conditioned binding

price_options.name: full_curve_3seed
price_options.note: all four budgets on all three seeds

price_options.name: curve_1seed
price_options.note: curve shape on the primary seed; A.5 showed the three seeds numerically identical

price_options.name: confirm_3seed_k8
price_options.note: k=8 only, as the replication arm

criteria.question: budget or ceiling: does the correction rate move with the per-error update budget
criteria.response_round: exact answer bytes plus EOS plus valid UTF-8, greedy, 65-byte cap
criteria.denominator: the 24 first-pass fit errors of the same subject, same template assignment
criteria.scaling_rule: the correction rate is non-decreasing in k and correction(8) - correction(1) >= 2/24
criteria.retention_is_not_tautological: the B updates touch byte_head and joint_readout, which the A task also uses, so the retention check can fail here; this is the opposite of the A.5 situation
criteria.rollback: none; the budget is the independent variable and rollback would erase it
criteria.re_ask: once per arm, after every error has consumed its budget
criteria.seed_note: the curve runs on the primary seed only; A.5 measured the three seeds to be numerically identical, so a three-seed curve would buy nothing at three times the price. A positive point must be replicated at that k in a follow-up card, not extrapolated
criteria.start_state: A.5 pre-feedback bundle per seed, byte-identical
